title: After-School Coding Clubs and Digital Literacy Outcomes: A Prospective Cohort Study
abstract: A prospective cohort study comparing digital literacy outcomes for students attending after-school coding clubs versus a matched comparison group.

title: Parental Mediation and Youth Digital Literacy: A Cross-Sectional Survey
abstract: A cross-sectional survey examining the association between parental mediation strategies and adolescents' self-reported digital literacy.

title: A Curriculum-Based Digital Literacy Program for Secondary School Students: A Cluster Randomized Trial
abstract: A cluster randomized trial of a curriculum-based digital literacy program delivered to secondary school students across 12 schools.

title: Teacher-Led Media Literacy Instruction in Primary Schools: A Mixed-Methods Study
abstract: A mixed-methods study of teacher-led media literacy instruction in primary school classrooms, combining pre/post assessment with focus groups.
